# Review — bardo-thodol-004 (pp. 36–45)

## Pass 1

Checked against conventions.md, packet.md (the print, its fixes and the establishment log with the three readers' logs),
units.py and bardo-thodol-001.json (pilot), the units of 002 and 003, 003's review.md and glossary.json. All 49 units
were read word by word, from the original to `l` to `i`, and the notes were checked against the forms.
units.json was edited in place by script (indent 1, ensure_ascii=False, as the file was written). `w` changed in two units,
by division only: two words were joined, and no letter changed. check.py: 49 units, 4936 letters, PASS.

### Changes

- u. 9, 33 · w, l · minor · ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་ སྐུ་རུ / སྐུར was split into two words. The term is a lexical compound: the pilot has ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་སྐུ as one word, and 002 has ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྐུ / ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྐུར whole · joined to ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུ་རུ / ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར. `l` now reads "as-the-body-of-perfect-enjoyment", following 002's "as-the-body-of-truth". The glosser must key these two forms.
- u. 30 · n · minor · stem label. The note called blta "the print's spelling here of lta". blta is the future stem of lta (lta / bltas / blta / ltos), a proper form · now says so, and adds that the first day has lta and the sense is the same.
- u. 32 · n · minor · stem label. The note called bskyor "the print's other spelling of skyor". bskyor is the past and future stem of skyor · now says so, and explains that the request still gives the sense "hold up!", as on the first day.
- u. 13, 37 · i · minor · thams cad, "all", was not rendered ("the light of the element water / earth, wholly purified"). The note to u. 13 points it out as the print's own word · now "…, all of it wholly purified."
- u. 37 · n · minor · the log's difference at 42.4 was given only in part: the other recension has 'byung ba sa without thams cad · added, as the note to u. 13 does for day two.
- u. 16, 40 · n · minor · the log's differences at 38.5 and 43.3 were not mentioned: the other recension has "rainbow, light and rays" where the print has only rainbow and light · added.
- u. 29 · n · minor · the log's difference of sense at 40.5 was not mentioned: the print has thar pa'i dus, the other recension thon pa'i dus, "the time of getting out" · added.
- u. 9 · n · minor · Stug po bkod pa was called "the name of the buddha-field of the centre". The reader of 003 was told that Vairocana comes from the central realm Thig le brdal ba (003 u. 43), and nothing here explained the second name · the note now says "is here the name…" and recalls 003's name.
- u. 21 · i · minor · 'du shes was rendered "a feeling of delight". In this part "feeling" is tshor ba (u. 41, the aggregate of feeling), and 'du shes is "notion" (in `l`, and in 003 u. 49) · now "a notion of delight".
- about · minor · "Some, held back by pride, flee even from this". The text says that those of great pride and heavy sinful obscurations take fright at the hook of the light of compassion and flee (u. 34), not that pride holds them back · now "Some, heavy with pride and sin, are afraid even of the hook of this light and flee".
- about · style · "two goddesses" for sems ma, where `i` and the notes have "female bodhisattvas" · now "two female bodhisattvas".
- u. 17, 22, 31, 41, 46 · l, i, n · style · 'tsher ba (and mtsher, read as 'tsher) was rendered "glittering". 003 (u. 30, 50, `l` and `i`) and glossary.json (འཚེར་བ "shimmering, gleaming") have "shimmering" · now "shimmering" throughout (12 places).
- u. 7, 12, 36 · l · style · 'di skad was "this-way" / "thus". 002 (u. 24, 26) and 003 (u. 15) write "these-words", and the glossary has "these words" · u. 7 now "prayer these-words"; u. 12 and 36 now "these-words:". The note to u. 12 was brought into line ("'these words' … stands for 'say these words'").
- u. 12, 36 · l · style · "the departed's name by calling". 003 u. 15 has, for the same formula, "the dead-one's by-name having-called" · now "the dead-one's by-name calling" ('bod is the present stem, so "calling" is kept).
- u. 29 · n · style · "ma with a verb is past or a command" was loose: ma goes with past forms and with prohibitions (ma + present + cig, as 003's corrected note to u. 22 says), not with commands · now "ma goes with past forms and with prohibitions".
- u. 40 · n · style · "d+hu pe ma" is not EWTS: the aspirate is dh · now "dhu pe ma".
- u. 17 · n · style · "which the print itself writes in the same phrase on p. 39": this unit is itself on p. 39 (39.1), and the 'tsher meant is at 39.5 (u. 22) · now "a few lines below".
- u. 44 · i · style · "and run from it", where u. 20, the about and 003 u. 48 have "flee" for the same bros · now "and flee from it".
- u. 47 · l · style · "loosening, rest!" did not show la after glod as the clause joint, as `l` does elsewhere ("do, and,") · now "loosen, and, rest!".

Severity count: major 0 · minor 11 · style 9 (20 change lines).

### Checked and confirmed (no change)

- Misprint notes in the required form: u. 10 ཞི་སྡང → ཞེ་སྡང and བཀྲག → སྐྲག; u. 37 འབྱུང་བས → འབྱུང་བ་ས; u. 22 ལམ → ལ་མ (in the fix list this is a tsheg dropped mid-line, but naming it is right, because ལམ would be read as "path"). The contraction ནམཁའི is named in u. 40. The tsheg-only fixes at line joins need no note, as in 002 and 003.
- [?] readings are each called uncertain: དུད u. 19, དུ u. 21, འཕྲང u. 32 (also "(?)" in `l`), ལ (tsheg unseen) u. 46.
- Kept-as-printed readings from the log are each noted: mtsher (u. 17, then "as before"), du kha (21, 27), yongs (25, called uncertain, with "(?)" in `l`), yab yum kyi (18), bdag gis lad mo (7, "(?)"), sdig sgrib kyi (28), ma 'byung gis (29), sangs rgyas kyis sku (40, "(?)"), bzhogs shig (47). The guessed sense gsol ba thob cig / thob cig is called a guess (7, 24, 31).
- Stems and labels: 'ongs past of 'ong (1); bsags past of gsog (4); drongs imperative of 'dren, skyol imperative of skyel, yis the instrumental after a vowel (8); btab past of 'debs (9); spongs imperative of spong (30); zhog imperative of 'jog (47); byas and btab past with ma (49); tshud de, de after -d (29); 'jigs te and 'khyams te (te after -s); ma byed cig not called an imperative (3, 27).
- Other-recension differences of sense from the log are mentioned at 37.3 (u. 9), 37.5 (10), 38.1 / 38.2 / 38.3 (11, 13, 14), 38.5 lA sya ma (16), 39.1 (17), 39.5 (22), 40.1 (24), 40.2–3 (25), 40.4 (28), 40.5 bsran (29), 43.2 mA le ma (40), 44.1 (43), 44.2 (44), 44.3 (46), and now 38.5, 40.5, 42.4, 43.3. The log's "same sense" items are rightly left out.
- Divisions agree with conventions.md and with 002/003: ཡིན་ནོ, དེ་ཙ་ན, ཁྱོད་རང་ གི, ཐུགས་ཀ་ ནས, མིག་ གིས་ མི་ བཟོད་པ་ ཙམ་དུ, འོང་ གི / གིས, ཆོས་དབྱིངས, ཕུང་པོ split from its genitive (as 003 རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པའི་ ཕུང་པོ), མཉམ་པ་ཉིད་ ཀྱི་ ཡེ་ཤེས (as 003 ཆོས་ཀྱི་དབྱིངས་ ཀྱི་ ཡེ་ཤེས), འཇིགས་སྐྲག (as 002 u. 41), དབྱེར་མེད་དུ (as 002 u. 31), the names of realms and figures whole (མངོན་པར་དགའ་བའི, སྟུག་པོ་བཀོད་པའི, ནམ་མཁའི་སྙིང་པོ, བྱམས་པ་མེ་ཏྲི). ༈ stands as its own token before ཀྱཻ་མ (u. 32).
- Verse (u. 8, 32): six lines each, `v` set, nine syllables a line after kyai ma, and line counts in w, l and i are equal.
- House renderings: the between / bardo, face-introduce / point out, knowing / awareness, child of noble family, "rays" / "light-ray" for 'od zer, "lustreless" / "dull" for bkrag med, "natural radiance" for rang mdangs (as 003 u. 32), and "Turn … with faith and devotion, longingly" and the refuge formula word for word as 003 u. 52–53.
- `p` flags follow the sections (prayer result, change of day, address, aggregate, the moment of fear) much as 003 does.

### Findings considered and refused

- u. 13, 37 · `w` རྣམ་པར་ དག་པའི split, while རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད and རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པའི are whole: kept. rnam par dag pa is an adverb and a verb ("completely pure"), not a lexical noun; the two whole forms are a name and a term.
- u. 8, 32 · `w` ཡང་དག་ རྫོགས་པའི་ སངས་རྒྱས split: kept. It is a phrase in verse (adjective, participle, noun), not a fixed compound written as one; the note gives it as a title, which is enough.
- u. 11, 35 · `i` "the two together": gnyis alone is "the two"; "together" adds nothing the sense does not have. Kept as style.
- u. 12, 36 · `i` "Point him out again." for yang ngo sprad pa ni ("as for pointing out again"): the heading is turned into the instruction it is; the sense is unchanged. Kept.
- u. 14, 38 · `i` "elephant throne" / "horse throne" for gdan, "seat", where 003 used "throne" for khri: `l` has "seat", the note glosses gdan "seat", and "throne" is the plain English for a deity's seat. Kept.
- u. 8, 32 · `i` "may … lead the way, may … support me" for imperatives: a prayer's imperatives are requests, and line 5 ("I pray you") gives the force. Kept.
- u. 11 · n "the two that come are the bright light and the dull one", where the Tibetan names the host of deities and the bad karma of hell: it is an explanation of what the pair stands for, offered in light of the days' pattern. Kept.
- u. 5, 8 · n dgag pa and bsgral given without their stems (dgag future of 'gog, bsgral future of sgrol): nothing false is said. Kept.
- u. 34 · n bros pas "because they flee", where `l` has "fled-because" (bros is past of 'bros): the note gives the sense of the clause, and `l` shows the stem. Kept.
- u. 9, 33 · `l` "dissolving, then" for thim nas (elsewhere "having-…"): thim has one form for all stems, and 003 also writes "X, then," for nas. Kept.
- u. 14, 38 · no `p` where 003 u. 43 had one before the buddha's appearance: here the day's paragraph opens at u. 12 / 36 with the address and runs through the appearance. Kept.
- u. 41 · `i` "too bright for the eye to look at" for blta mi bzod pa: this is the sense of "unbearable to look at" and not a known translation's wording. Kept.
- u. 22 · ལམ → ལ་མ named as "a misprint" though the fix list counts it as a tsheg dropped mid-line: read_B calls it a contraction, and the note's statement (the print has ལམ; ལ་མ is meant) is true either way. Kept.
